reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the coherent ordered nanoprecipitate strategy from soft magnetic high-entropy alloys (P7, P17, P14) to MnNiSi-based magnetocaloric materials, but the mechanism and predicted outcome are taken almost verbatim from those passages without adaptation to the different material system or its magnetostructural transformation. The core idea is a restatement of the prior work's concept, merely applied to a new alloy family with no new mechanistic insight or integration of magnetocaloric-specific evidence.

precipitate size below domain wall width to avoid pinning
